title: History record projection
responsibility: Builds the display form of a verification record with resolved media and explicit inherited evidence origins.

inputs.name: recordView.record
inputs.description: Stored verification record to project without changing its results.

inputs.name: recordView.context
inputs.type: { valid: boolean; problems: string[]; resolve: MediaResolver; /** The checks an earlier record ran, by its id; undefined when it cannot be read. */ origins?: (record: string) => Array<{ id: string; status: string }> | undefined; }
inputs.description: Validity and problems supplied by the caller, a media resolver, and optional lookup for origin-record test summaries.

outputs.name: recordView
outputs.description: Record view retaining source, timings, gates, measurements, budgets and reason status, with concise tests and captures augmented by resolved media/gaps. Inherited scenarios name their actual origin and scoped origin tests when available.
